summary: 3D arcade driving game with a yellow shared minibus in a low-poly Istanbul neighbourhood, built by Claude Sonnet 5.5 · Alçak poligon bir İstanbul mahallesinde sarı dolmuşla 3D arcade sürüş, Claude Sonnet 5.5 yaptı
key_features: Stop, open the door and pick up waving passengers; each one names their stop in a chat bubble, 12 seats
Tips for fast and smooth rides; red lights, crashes, hard braking and skipped passengers cost money
Eight shifts and an endless mode with a tram, rain, a VIP passenger, a traffic jam and a night shift
The ?auto bot finished all 8 levels with the same controls and rules as a player
About 60 fps (vsync cap) on an Intel UHD 630 laptop at 1280x720 with 42 draw calls; one index.html, optional CC0 asset pass

social.headline: Drive a yellow dolmuş through Istanbul: pick up passengers, learn their stops, earn fares and tips · Sarı dolmuşla İstanbul'da yolcu al, durağını öğren, ücret ve bahşiş topla
